summary: San Francisco Bay Area, audio engineering, computer science background, strong interest in digital signal processing (DSP), expertise in audio codecs (CELT, MP3, Vorbis), active in open-source software communities, critical of copyright practices, engaged in discussions about cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, Solidcoin), interest in public domain and archival projects (archive.org, OpenStreetMap), skeptical of proprietary licensing models, advocate for free access to information.
